title: Pre-closure Checklist — Always-clickable Close Claim button with status checklist
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — CLM-2024-001 has open tasks + open sections (blockers present)
Observe: 'Close Claim' button is visible and clickable (primary style, not disabled/tooltipped)
Click 'Close Claim' — modal opens at Pre-closure Checklist
Observe: 7 condition rows, blocked items show red exclamation icon + 'Blocked' badge
Observe: 'Continue' button is disabled because not all conditions are clear
Apply AC-02 — all tasks done, all sections closed, no other blockers
Click 'Close Claim' — modal checklist shows all 7 rows with green check + 'Clear' badge
Click Continue → Reason step → select reason → Continue → Confirmation → Close Claim

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given blockers exist, Close Claim is always clickable; modal opens and shows blocked conditions with Continue disabled.
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The **Close Claim** button is always rendered as an enabled primary button (never disabled with a tooltip). When clicked with active blockers, the modal opens at the **Pre-closure Checklist** step — each condition row shows a **Blocked** badge (red) or **Clear** badge (green). The **Continue** button is disabled while any condition is blocked.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 with open tasks and open sections so blockers are present in the checklist.

preconditions.text: 'Close Claim' button is rendered and clickable (primary style, not disabled)
Clicking 'Close Claim' opens modal — title 'Close Claim — Pre-closure Checklist'
'All sections closed' row shows Blocked badge (red icon)
'Continue' button in modal footer is disabled

expectedUI.description: Close Claim button is primary (enabled). Modal checklist shows conditions with blocked rows for tasks and sections. Continue is disabled.
visualCues: Close Claim button: primary style, not greyed out, no tooltip
Blocked rows: red exclamation icon, red 'Blocked' badge, detail text from blocker label
Clear rows: green check icon, green 'Clear' badge

howToTest.expectedResult: Modal opens at checklist, blocked rows visible, Continue disabled

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Given all conditions are clear, the checklist shows all green and Continue is enabled.
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When all closure conditions are met (tasks done, sections closed, no other blockers), all 7 checklist rows show a **Clear** badge (green check icon) and the **Continue** button is enabled. Proceeding leads to Reason → Confirmation → successful claim closure.

setup.description: All tasks done, all sections closed, no litigation/reserves/payments/provider blockers on CLM-2024-001.

preconditions.text: Clicking Continue navigates to Reason step

expectedUI.description: All 7 condition rows show green check icon + 'Clear' badge. Continue is enabled. Flow: checklist → reason → confirmation → closed.
visualCues: All rows: green check icon (check-circle-o), green 'Clear' badge
After Continue: modal title changes to 'Close Claim — Reason'
After second Continue (with reason): 'Close Claim — Confirmation' with retention selection
After Close Claim: status chip updates to Closed

howToTest.trigger: Click 'Close Claim', then Continue, select reason, Continue, Close Claim
howToTest.expectedResult: Claim status changes to Closed, closure panel visible
